label: A hundred scored prompts, four times the declared floor: a graded corpus at high confidence.

authoredAgainst.why: Every expected value below was derived by hand from exactly these numbers. If one of them changes, this file is wrong until a person re-derives it — that is the whole reason the numbers are copied here rather than read from the modules.

expectedValuesAreHandAuthored: Composite = (72x100 + 18x55 + 10x35) / 100 = (7200 + 990 + 350) / 100 = 85.4, reported to 0 decimals as 85, which is a B (>= 80). Intent = (72x100 + 18x80 + 10x50) / 100 = 91.4. Efficiency = (72x100 + 18x50 + 10x0) / 100 = 81. Model fit = (72x100 + 18x0 + 10x50) / 100 = 77. Recomposed: (50x91.4 + 30x81 + 20x77) / 100 = 85.4. Confidence = 100 scored / 25 floor = 4.00x, which clears the high tier; the classified share is 1, so nothing is downgraded. Nothing here was produced by calling the module.
